method: Direct image inspection with view_image; numeric saved-model audits and full video decoding are separate.
movie_sample_review: Inspected 16 labeled samples per film, including guard/fill/hold/vent, hook transition, uppercut, diagonal and final guard. No obvious new detachment or framing clipping in inspected samples.
findings: Full product remains in frame; rear orbit can occlude one arm, complemented by branch view.
Inherited palm/carrier/opponent and qualitative U/F/T labels remain readable at full frame.
Positive nominal cover gaps are narrow at whole-product scale; comparison plot and audited Z bounds provide the quantitative evidence.
N3 bow preserves visually continuous layered routing in inspected branch views.
limitations: Not every decoded video frame was visually inspected.
No browser playback or interactive HTML layout validation.
Workbench renders omit textile textures and cannot qualify clearance, pressure, contact, retention or durability.
